pages.text: $(item)Empty Pages$() are the base stock. $(item)Leather$() by itself in the $(thing)Book Binder$() creates a blank $(item)Descriptive Book$(), which is how you begin collecting and arranging symbols.

$(item)Leather$() plus an $(item)Empty Page$() in the binder creates a $(item)Linking Book$(). If symbol pages are in the binder too, they are left behind instead of being consumed, so you can write a link without destroying your grammar pages.
